title:
The Blindman's World
1898
author: Edward Bellamy
description: "The Blindman's World" by Edward Bellamy is a fictional narrative written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: This unique work combines elements of science fiction and philosophical exploration, presenting a captivating dialogue on existence, foresight, and the human condition through the lens of a professor who experiences a transformative vision of life on Mars.

authorInfo.bio: Edward Bellamy was an American author, journalist, and political activist most famous for his utopian novel Looking Backward. Bellamy's vision of a harmonious future world inspired the formation of numerous "Nationalist Clubs" dedicated to the propagation of state ownership of the main pillars of the economy, achieved through nationalization.
